notes:
REF-BM-02: Title and description are collected, but favicon and preview image are not.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate creation is prevented and the existing ID is returned, but the UI does not directly open editing and cannot locate an archived duplicate in the active view.
REF-BM-07: Cards show title, description, and tags, but use a generated initial instead of a favicon.
REF-BM-08: A domain link opens the original URL, but selecting the card/list item itself does not.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated field with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, URL, and tags, but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: #tag query syntax is not parsed.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not implemented.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: Multiple selection and bulk actions are absent.
REF-BM-21: Filter-scoped whole-collection actions are absent.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Persistent adjustable display settings are absent.
